2) LA to San Francisco (SF), bicycling.

3) SF back to NYC using public transit.

Also for public transport from SF to NYC would involve flights etc. Traffic may refer to delays on roads? Public transit includes trains/buses/planes. Could mention potential delays due to weather.

First call: start NY, end LA, mode=driving.
